program.name: Climb Supersets
program.subject: Climber / pull strength
program.blurb: Climbing pulls paired with the pushing muscles climbers forget.
program.about: Pulling strength with the balance climbers need. Each superset pairs a climbing pull or hang with a press or push, so the shoulders stay even. Two days alternate. Abs finish every session. Level II moves you one weight up and Level III brings harder variations.
